meta.name: abp-dependency-rules
meta.description: ABP Framework v10.x (10.4/10.5) layer dependency rules quick reference: layer direction, project reference matrix, anti-patterns (no DbContext in Application, don't expose IQueryable, don't return entity as DTO). Use when you need layer architecture/dependency rules in ABP.

copy.tagline: 快速查阅ABP框架层依赖规则
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在使用ABP框架并需要确保层依赖合规
copy.tagline_en: Look up ABP framework layer dependency rules quickly
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use ABP framework and need to ensure layer dependency compliance

howto.what: Claude 能根据 ABP v10.x 的层依赖规则，检查你的项目结构是否符合规范（如引用方向、禁止在Application层使用DbContext等），并指出常见违规模式。
howto.when: 当你提到“ABP层架构”、“依赖规则”等关键词，或询问项目中DbContext应放在哪里时触发。

say.text: 检查我的ABP项目层引用是否正确？
say.note: Claude会列出各层的允许引用关系。
Claude会解释禁止原因并建议改用Repository。
Claude会指出这违反了上层依赖下层的规则。

howto.what_en: Claude can check if your ABP v10.x project structure follows layer dependency rules (e.g., reference direction, no DbContext in Application), and flag common anti-patterns.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like 'ABP layer architecture', 'dependency rules', or ask where DbContext should be placed in the project.

say_en.text: Check if my ABP project layer references are correct?
say_en.note: Claude lists allowed references per layer.

say_en.text: Can Application layer directly use DbContext?
say_en.note: Claude explains the anti-pattern and suggests using Repository.

say_en.text: Can Domain layer reference Application layer?
say_en.note: Claude confirms this violates upward dependency rule.
